title: AccessMap
summary: Mobile app for flagging accessibility barriers — broken ramps, missing tactile paths — pinned to a real city map. Privacy-first: no tracking, no data sold.

heroImage.alt: Warm-toned mockup of the AccessMap mobile interface showing accessibility flags pinned to a city map

title: Claude Corp
summary: An 18-role AI team governed by a written Constitution. Each agent owns a domain; an orchestrator runs the cycles. The infrastructure behind this portfolio.

heroImage.alt: A printed Constitution document on a linen surface beside a single terracotta-toned cup

title: Prompt Library
summary: Local-first prompt manager in Next.js 15. Prompts stay in the browser, API key never leaves the machine. Fifty features shipped across twenty stacked branches.

heroImage.alt: A quiet workspace with a notebook of prompts open beside a laptop, soft natural light from the side

title: Pac-Man Code Trainer
summary: CLI commands turned into a retro arcade game. Forty flashcards covering Claude Code and macOS shortcuts, zero dependencies, runs straight from GitHub Pages.

heroImage.alt: Retro pixel-art Pac-Man grid showing flashcard commands on a dark arcade background

title: Mutual Mesh
summary: Mutual-aid app connecting neighbours who want to help with those who need it. Privacy-first: a PRIVACY.md gate blocks every new feature before any code ships.

heroImage.alt: Two hands passing a small bundle across a kitchen table, soft window light from the left
